THE FINE PRINT, MADE READABLE

Odds, not promises.

What is being compared?

No lock: remove any lock craft and Divine until all targets hit together.

Specific modifier (1-lock / 2-lock): use the selected lock size while your chosen variable modifier meets its target; remove it when that target is lost. The protected modifier is still random.

All target rolls: use a 1-mod craft with one successful variable modifier, a 2-mod craft with two. Fixed and always-satisfied modifiers never trigger these locks. Re-evaluate after every roll. “All” is a strategy name, not guaranteed protection.

Optimal adaptive: choose no craft, a 1-mod craft or a 2-mod craft in each state to minimize expected total cost, including switching costs.

What goes into the math?

Uniform, independent rolls within the entered tier ranges, with inclusive endpoints. A modifier with multiple numeric rolls hits only when all its targets hit. Group hybrid stats under one modifier; a lock protects the entire modifier.

Each Divine selects a fresh, uniformly random set of distinct modifiers to protect. The remaining modifiers reroll. The calculator solves the resulting finite-state equations exactly up to floating-point precision; it does not estimate with random samples.

For a plain Divine, the success chance is the product of the modifier chances. From an unfinished item, its average roll count is 1 ÷ that chance. Average spending is not a guaranteed budget.

Scope & crafting rules

One side of a rare item at a time, up to three modifiers. Locks need an opposite-side slot. An imported removable bench craft on that side is assumed to be removed for the first lock, freeing its slot. The no-lock strategy keeps it. Recrafting the original modifier afterward is not included. The other side can reroll; these results do not preserve it or optimize a whole six-mod item.

Fractured and fixed-value modifiers are already satisfied and excluded from strategy lock triggers, but remain in the random-lock pool. Corrupted, mirrored and unmodifiable flags are ignored for planning; this does not establish in-game crafting eligibility. No lucky rolls, quality/catalyst rounding, Hinekora's Locks or other crafting methods. Use unscaled ranges. Full-side locks cannot improve that same side and are excluded.

Defaults: 1 Divine for a 1-mod craft, 2 for a 2-mod craft. Random-per-Divine behavior is an explicit model assumption confirmed by this tool's requester; verify in-game after patches.
